en: {player}... I lost to you, but I'm not giving up. I'm going to get stronger, as strong as you!
The air here is so clean, I feel better already. Ralts and I are going to train every single day.
I'll get stronger, {player}. Just you wait!
Wally's in the next room, so to speak. He's been training with his Ralts from morning till night!
My daughter's young man is so devoted. He's been digging a tunnel from Rustboro just to see her!
So it was you who helped break through the tunnel? My daughter's young man was digging for weeks!
Don't worry about my cousin Wally. He's frail, but he's tougher than he looks.
You must be {player}! Wally hasn't stopped talking about you since he came back from Mauville.
